title: One eval: LIT + EMA + Asia slot, EMA at LIT's need size

verdict: Eval path (fresh eval every session, 20 sessions; $ = back-to-back eval path). 2026 H1 (pick) 5.51/wk net +42,250 ($6,932/mo) DD -2,033; 2-week pass/fail 61.3/2.5, 1 month 67.0/11.0, median 4.0 sessions. H2 (check) 4.55/wk net +13,375 ($3,601/mo) DD -1,919; 2-week pass/fail 66.7/0.0, 1 month 74.6/0.0, median 4.0 sessions. Reference 2025 4.57/wk net +4,291 ($349/mo) DD -8,516; 2-week pass/fail 22.1/24.1, 1 month 26.4/51.9, median 5.0 sessions; 2021-24 4.82/wk net -5,012 ($-129/mo) DD -25,324; 2-week pass/fail 22.9/23.7, 1 month 24.8/58.4, median 3.0 sessions (LIT on 5m there).
notes: tools/second_mix.py (PICKS); stored trades = the back-to-back eval path of each span (2021-24, 2025, H1, H2); the run library's own eval columns re-score that path by day and are not the published odds (those are in the verdict).
